assembly_rule: System text = the neutral sentence, then the separator, then the whole file verbatim (title line included). C0 is the sentence alone. C2null is used only by run_trial.py --null and is a second copy of C1.
word_count_method: whitespace-separated tokens: Python str.split() on the file text, which gives the same number as wc -w here. Markdown marks such as '#' and '1.' count as words in both files.
note: run_trial.py re-hashes both files at start and refuses to run if either sha256 differs from this file. If the sheet is archived to a new path, update its path here and rerun selftest.py; the sha256 must not change.
